rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) - allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For covered older rental units, rent may be raised only once every 12 months, by the allowable percentage set by the city (3% for 7/1/2025-6/30/2026). Since Feb. 2, 2026 no extra percentage for utilities or an added dependent is allowed; a 10% increase for an additional non-dependent tenant is still permitted.
rules.key_value: Once per 12 months, by annual allowable percentage (3% for 7/1/2025-6/30/2026)
rules.citation: L.A. Mun. Code ch. XV, § 151.00 et seq.
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
rules.effective_date_note: Date of the current formula changes (no utility or dependent add-on) per LAHD; the underlying RSO is older and its original date is not in the documents.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28.
rules.exemptions: Condominiums/townhomes: rent not regulated for tenancies commenced after Dec. 31, 1995. Luxury exemption by application.
rules.interaction: Local RSO covers the unit instead of the state cap (Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12) where both would apply.
rules.conflict_note: Two published effective dates for the new formula: LAHD says 2026-02-02; a landlord association reportedly gave 2026-01-24. LAHD (official) date used.

rules.title: Los Angeles Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: For covered units not under the RSO, a landlord may end a tenancy only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons; no-fault evictions require relocation assistance. Eviction notices must be filed with LAHD within 3 business days of service, and nonpayment evictions are barred unless rent owed exceeds Fair Market Rent.
rules.key_value: Just cause required; relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.effective_date_note: No effective date for the core JCO in the documents; nonpayment FMR threshold effective 2023-03-27; right-to-counsel notice from 2025-08-20.
rules.coverage_conditions: Most residential properties not covered by the RSO (newer than Oct 1, 1978, and single-family dwellings).
rules.exemptions: Transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity/sorority houses, owner's roommate, certain cooperatives, some nonprofit facilities, some HACLA/government property.
rules.interaction: Applies to units not covered by the RSO.
rules.review_note: Municipal code section not stated on the LAHD page; chapter cite inferred from LAMC 165.03/165.05/165.06 references in other LAHD documents. The JCO does not regulate rent increases.

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO - legal reasons for eviction and notices
rules.requirement: Landlords of RSO units may evict only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons. Eviction notices must be filed with LAHD within 3 business days, no-fault evictions require relocation assistance and a Declaration of Intent to Evict, and the Notice of Right to Counsel must be attached to eviction notices.
rules.key_value: Just cause required; 3-business-day LAHD filing; relocation for no-fault
rules.quoted_span: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance
rules.effective_date_note: No original effective date in documents; right-to-counsel notice required from 2025-08-20.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units subject to the RSO (first built on or before Oct. 1, 1978).

rules.title: LA RSO/JCO no-fault eviction relocation assistance and declaration filing
rules.requirement: Before a no-fault eviction from an RSO or JCO unit, the landlord must file a Declaration of Intent to Evict with LAHD, serve notice only afterward, file a copy within 3 days, and pay relocation assistance within 15 days of the notice. For 7/1/2026-6/30/2027 amounts are $11,000 to $27,400 per unit by tenant status and tenancy length.
rules.key_value: $11,000-$27,400 per unit (7/1/2026-6/30/2027); one month's rent for qualifying single-family JCO dwellings
rules.quoted_span: All tenant not- at-fault evictions require payment of relocation assistance and the filing of a Declaration of Intent to Evict form with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD)
rules.effective_date_note: Current amounts effective 2026-07-01 (increase each July 1); original effective date of the requirement not stated.
rules.exemptions: No relocation when replacing a resident manager with another, or for natural-disaster hazards not caused by landlord negligence. Reduced amounts for Mom and Pop owner/family occupancy evictions.
rules.penalty: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration makes the eviction a violation of the RSO or JCO; tenant may raise nonpayment as an affirmative defense.

unverifiable_exemptions: single-family dwellings and other JCO exemptions

rules.title: LA Resident Protections Ordinance: demolition for new construction relocation and occupant protections
rules.requirement: When Protected Units are demolished for new construction, owners must pay the higher of State Housing Crisis Act or City relocation. Lower-income households receive standardized payments of $87,450 to $115,480 under Option 1, plus a right to remain up to 6 months, right to return and right of first refusal.
rules.key_value: $87,450 (low), $96,750 (very low), $115,480 (extremely low) per unit under Option 1
rules.citation: L.A. Ordinance Nos. 188481 and 188482 (Resident Protections Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: On February 11, 2025, the Los Angeles City Council adopted the RPO which codified and expanded upon replacement requirements and occupant protections of the HCA
rules.effective_date_note: Bulletin says RPO effective 2/11/2025 under Ordinances #188481 and #188482; council adoption same date.
rules.penalty: Financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances.

requires_unknown_facts: unit is a Protected Unit (RSO unit, or rent-restricted or lower-income occupied within past 5 years) being demolished for new construction

rules.title: LA RSO security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords of rent-stabilized units must pay tenants accrued interest on security deposits monthly or yearly, as a direct payment or rent credit, and tell the tenant in writing which method they chose.
rules.key_value: Interest paid monthly or annually; rate set annually by the City (4.32% for 2025)
rules.quoted_span: A tenant shall be given the unpaid accrued interest in the form of either a direct payment or a credit against the tenant’s rent
rules.effective_date_note: Interest began accruing November 1, 1990, per quoted code text.
rules.penalty: Non-compliance can be raised as a defense in eviction proceedings (per source article).
rules.review_note: Only a secondary source (AAGLA) gives the operative text; the official RSO overview page only lists security deposit interest as an RSO topic.

unverifiable_exemptions: condos, single-family homes and other RSO exemptions cannot be verified from parcel data

no_rule_findings.finding: Only a September 2024 council motion asking LAHD to report on algorithm-based rent-setting software and the feasibility of a ban. No enacted city ordinance in the documents.
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on the use of this software to set rents in the City

dropped_candidates.reason: Kept as the no_rule_finding for algorithmic_rent_setting (motion, not a law).
Not a no-rule finding: LA has the RSO rent cap; the JCO simply does not regulate rent, so it is not a gap in the rent_increase_limits category.

parsed.notes: LA is covered by RSO (built on or before 1978-10-01) and the complementary JCO (after). No documents were provided for application fees or screening restrictions at the city level, so no records or findings were added for them. The link-only code source D038 could not be read.
